extra.reason: Pipeline built: make gsb/fetch, make gsb, make gsb/check; NT tables (Nestle1904 + restored TR) generated; LXX stage reads our own Swete transcription (none transcribed yet); lexicon/strongs.tsv; reports. Uncommitted.

Site at /bible/versions/gsb/text/ (scripts/gsb-site.scm, make gsb/site, part of make render), translation format gsb/translation/README.md, checker make gsb/lint (run by make test), concordance gsb/lexicon/glosses.scm, draft John 1:1-5. Verified in headless Chrome.

Ported to Guile: scripts/lib/swete.scm (hOCR main-text extraction, LCS collation via (scripts lib gsb) lcs-ops, classes R0-R7 + mandatory checks H1-H3, page parsing, verse tables, validation), CLI scripts/gsb-swete.sh (box, strips, collate, decide, flag, zoom, done, status, merge), test scripts/lib/test/swete/test.scm. Per-leaf decision sidecars; merge builds decisions.tsv/provenance.tsv/NN tables. Procedure: .claude/skills/gsb-transcribe/SKILL.md. Proven on Gen leaves 38-41.

Implemented: tables use common numbering; page files keep Swete's {Cn}{n} and record the margin's parenthesized common reference as {=c:v} (Gen 3:1 = 2:25+3:1, Gen 6:1 = 5:32+6:1; Daniel 1 has none). Brackets kept, ¶/§ kept in pages and dropped from tables, {P} paragraphs and {S} poetry lines recorded in pages. Daniel page dir renamed pages/dan-og -> pages/dan to match books.tsv (55-dan.tsv, 56-dan-th.tsv). Documented in gsb/sources/swete/README.md.
